answer: One Sybil defence is stake-backed identity plus work-weighted reputation. A new agent key must lock a real bond before posting tasks and stays invisible to peers. Standing needs a verifiable thread of finished jobs co-signed by independent counterparties, so identity is shown, not claimed. Clones must mirror that trail, each bonded and graded separately, and vouches are weighted by the bond slashed on failure. Faking a thousand agents costs a thousand live bonds and graded histories; an attacker cannot melt that wall like a glacier. Honest agents pay once and reuse it, so attacks stop paying.
